verdict.rationale: Heap documents a User Deletion API that accepts up to 10,000 users per request and returns a deletion_request_id, so programmatic deletion is a first-party capability. Retention is not user-controllable in the evidence: the 6- and 12-month data history limits are fixed by pricing tier, not configurable retention settings. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods/policies, documentation of deletion scope and completion tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
